name: review-loop
description: Take a change from plan to your acceptance: an independent reviewer checks the plan and the code, an adversarial gate tests the result, then quality polish, docs and a security review. Also reviews PRs and existing code.

interface.shortDescription: Plan-Execute-Review workflows driven by the paired-session coordinator
interface.longDescription: review-loop drives work items through the paired-session coordinator: independent plan review, implementation and review, an adversarial gate, quality polish, docs and security up to your acceptance. The review-loop entry hands fresh work, an existing plan or a review of existing code to paired-session; the legacy workflow was removed in v2.13.0. Codex marketplace install exposes four native skills (guide, review-loop, paired-session, review-pr) under `.agents/skills/`.
defaultPrompt: use paired-session to plan this task (plan only)
